verdict.summary: The opt-in slow-query log is correctly feature- and runtime-gated, records the already-measured request duration without re-executing the query, re-plans against the pinned snapshot, bounds retained data, and protects raw query text with the write/admin authorization gate. The HTTP integration tests exercise the real /sparql recording path, threshold behavior, disarmed route, and authorization boundary; unit tests cover ring policy and measurement handoff. Public configuration, CLI/env controls, feature-matrix coverage, and operator documentation are updated consistently. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect requiring changes was found.
